row.proto: void Career_Rebuild_SeasonStandings(void *season, void *order_a, void *order_b, void *extra_points, void *extra_e)
row.notes: clears the four standings (season+0x2a8, *+0x510, *+0x520, *+0x530); if weekend[0] has sessions, re-inits them via 0x1413cf090 (only caller) with copies of four optional vectors {alloc*, begin, end, count, u8 engaged@+0x20}; extra_points {u32 entrant key, i32 points} -> 0x1413ccb90 stores it at standings+0xa8 (model adds it, vt+0x40 0x140b2fc20) and 0x1413cfb70 sums it per team; extra_e is stored on the constructors side at standings+0x210; then re-applies results (0x140aecf80) and recomputes points, and finally frees each engaged caller list with its alloc vt+0x38 and zeroes it. Callers Season start 0x140ae35a0 and Career_Rebuild_ChampionshipStandings (V0234)

verify.notes: V0234 5 args confirmed (arg5 at rsp+0x170); 0x1413cf090 has one caller (0x140ae8663); +0xa8 store and vt+0x40 0x140b2fc20 (.data1 0x14961b930) reader check. Wrong/missing: the re-init is conditional: if the season has no weekends or weekend[0]'s session vector +0x220..+0x228 is empty, 0x1413cf090 is skipped and all four lists are dropped (still freed); the function deep-copies each list for 0x1413cf090 and then frees the caller's four engaged buffers itself; extra_e goes to the constructors side (standings+0x210), not as extra driver points. Corrected: clears the four standings (season+0x2a8, *+0x510, *+0x520, *+0x530); if weekend[0] has sessions, re-inits them via 0x1413cf090 (only caller) with copies of four optional vectors {alloc*, begin, end, count, u8 engaged@+0x20}; extra_points {u32 entrant key, i32 points} -> 0x1413ccb90 stores it at standings+0xa8 (model adds it, vt+0x40 0x140b2fc20) and 0x1413cfb70 sums it per team; extra_e is stored on the constructors side at standings+0x210; then re-applies results (0x140aecf80) and recomputes points, and finally frees each engaged caller list with its alloc vt+0x38 and zeroes it. Callers Season start 0x140ae35a0 and Career_Rebuild_ChampionshipStandings

V0303 Independent: 5 args (arg5 [rsp+0x170] after 8 pushes+0x108), clears +0x2a8 and *+0x510/+0x520/+0x530, skips 0x1413cf090 when no weekends, weekend[0] +0x220==+0x228 or begin 0; 0x1413cf090(+0x2a8, session0+0x18, copies) -> 0x1413ccb90 fills +0xa8, 0x1413cfb70 (thunk) team side, extra_e matched by key against +0x120 list into +0x210; 0x140aecf80(season,1) and recompute; caller lists freed and zeroed; callers 0x140ae35a0, 0x140ae78f0. Wording notes: vector +0x18 is capacity (copy alloc size), not count; +0xa8 becomes one {key, points-or-0} per weekend[0] session-0 entrant, extra keys not among them are dropped.
